Fixture Scripps Research Internships

Undergraduate and high school research opportunities at Scripps Institution of Oceanography.

Fixture JT-SURF

A 10-week paid summer research fellowship. Applications open December 1 and are due February 15. Open to current high school juniors and seniors residing in San Diego County.

Fixture MPL Summer Internship

A paid summer internship in marine physical laboratory research. Applications open December 1 and are due March 1. Open to current high school seniors.

Fixture CW3E Undergraduate Fellowship

An unpaid undergraduate research fellowship studying atmospheric rivers. Rolling admissions; no fixed deadline this cycle.
